cards.back: Shanti’s parents seemed busier planning their summer vacation.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Some Unique Places'?
cards.back: “Are we doing something different this year?”, she asked.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Some Unique Places'?
cards.back: “Maybe we could go to more places rather than staying in one place?

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Some Unique Places'?
cards.back: I really want to see more of our country now that I am growing up.” Appa (father) and Amma (mother) smiled, “Shanti, your wish might just come true.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Some Unique Places'?
cards.back: A trip to a few different places starting from the southernmost tip of India!”.
